# Limitations

Our claim is scoped to Gemma~3 270M, the PT+affine Gemma Scope~2 CLT
dictionary, occupation \(a\)/\(an\) prompts, and the interventions we ran.
The model is in a weak behavioral regime for this task. We did not isolate
a pure context concept \(A\), nor run dedicated semantic-concept probes
beyond noun-token outcomes. Many same-class targets begin several logits
behind the source, so top-1 nulls can reflect floor effects. The residual
hint-contrast construction is one dense baseline and can be weaker than
matched random directions; oracle activation patching is a stronger but
still incomplete positive control. Scale and model-family generalization
are outside our local compute envelope. Affine skip means sparse
interventions need not exhaust MLP computation.
